long_biography.plain_text:
Kyriakou qualified as a lawyer at the University of Sydney in 1974 and spent about six years in private practice. He then joined the company that became Natasa Mining as chief executive, beginning a resources career that combined operating control with investment and finance. His work subsequently extended across Australia, Canada, Africa and Mexico.

His board record included executive positions at Giant Yellowknife Mines, Pamour Mines, West Witwatersrand Gold Holdings, Bow River Diamonds and Minera Roca Roja. He held ownership interests in the Pamour group and a Toronto financing company, then helped develop resource projects from exploration through project finance and commissioning. The breadth of those roles established mining as his defining career, despite his legal training.
